visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of promotional cards: Dynamic Media personalized image, two-line title, pill CTA button, description
visualCharacteristics.layout: responsive grid, 4-up on desktop, wrapping on smaller screens; card body centred

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = image (picture, image link or plain-text Dynamic Media URL with overlay/text parameters, used as authored); cell 2 = body: title paragraph, CTA paragraph holding one link, description

usage: Product and tour promotions with a call-to-action button (RESERVE NOW / BUY NOW).
reuseGuidance: Use when each card needs a title, a CTA and a description. For image plus short caption only, use cards-caption.
